title: Regional exposure support sensitivity
source: Eurostat lfst_r_lfe2emp and prior fixed regional THAIE linkage
note: 135 regions from the original 208-region cohort with at least 50 disclosed mapped occupational cells in 2022. Original quintile cutoffs are frozen, not reranked. This is an exposure-support sensitivity, not a representative or certified-coverage sample. Suppressed cells remain unavailable.
